presets.name: Яркий симулятор
presets.description: Солнечный мир, крупные рисованные кнопки слева и свободный центр экрана.
presets.signature: Вертикальная навигация · крупные предметы · светлый игровой мир
presets.lighting: Bright clear daylight, soft contact shadows and readable saturated landmarks
presets.avatar: Chunky, friendly block silhouette with a small colorful accessory
presets.world: Spacious grassy lane, broad block cliffs, a striped shop stall and rounded trees
presets.typography: Heavy white labels with a dark outline; large clean resource numbers
presets.hud: Objective at top center, illustrated left navigation, resource counters at bottom left
presets.menu: Bright central panel with a large play action and illustrated feature tiles
presets.shop: Three large item cards, prominent illustrations and one action per card
presets.inventory: Airy item grid and a highlighted selected card with a separate equip action
presets.mobile: Bottom navigation strip and compact currency; hide secondary actions in menu

presets.name: Тактический tycoon
presets.description: Предметный мир, металлические панели и компактная горизонтальная навигация.
presets.signature: Пояс снаряжения · тёмные панели · список и описание предмета
presets.lighting: Clear outdoor lighting, contained cyan signals and restrained amber accents
presets.avatar: Practical expedition silhouette with a compact utility backpack
presets.world: Low coastal horizon, industrial landing pad, angular workshop and equipment stands
presets.typography: Compact bold labels, dark beveled panels and explicit keyboard hints
presets.hud: Currency at upper left, compact objective strip and equipment belt at bottom
presets.menu: Left information column with a disciplined mission panel and clear primary action
presets.shop: Side categories and illustrated item list with a persistent detail pane
presets.inventory: Equipment list, large selected item and visible slots along the bottom
presets.mobile: Stack item list and details; group equipment and retain a 44px primary action

presets.name: Неоновый clicker
presets.description: Неоновые порталы, сетка выразительных иконок и большая панель прогресса.
presets.signature: Сетка кнопок 2×3 · яркие события · крупная полоса прогресса
presets.lighting: Strong cyan and violet energy accents, controlled glow and clear central play space
presets.avatar: Bold block silhouette with a luminous accessory and contrasting outline
presets.world: Broad studded plaza, a large energy portal and stepped neon display stands
presets.typography: Extra-heavy outlined white labels, slanted highlights and saturated gradient tiles
presets.hud: Two-column illustrated navigation, right event rail and a wide bottom progress bar
presets.menu: Portal hero motif with an oversized play action and colorful feature cards
presets.shop: Large promotion cards with distinct item artwork, clear contents and one action
presets.inventory: Collection grid, rarity borders, selected item panel and strong equip state
presets.mobile: Collapse secondary navigation and promotions; keep progress and main action visible
